d: Centuries of vanished empires, plundered vaults, and deep-sea shipwrecks have left immense wealth hidden across the globe. Join intrepid explorer Josh Gates as he ventures into hostile terrain where Josh Gates hunts legendary lost gold alongside expert archaeologists and historians. The high-stakes mission of hunting billions in buried fortune takes investigative teams deep into subterranean cavern systems, forgotten jungle ruins, and sealed desert tombs. Every grueling trek pushes the boundaries of modern exploration, dedicated entirely to revealing the truth behind history’s lost…
